top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - According to Label Directions (26 TAC §746.3805(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A medication safe for the use of children ages 4yo and up was administered to a child age 3yo.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when parent was advised medication will not be administered unless amendment  in writing by the child s health-care professional is provided.

top_violation_types.title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Documentation showing children were signed into care was not available upon request.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the walkthrough, an infant was observed sleeping with a bib on.     Note: The bib was removed immediately

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 5 files evaluated did not contain proof of request for background check.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the five enrolled children's admission information was not available upon request.
